summary: Backend regression passed 2/2. Mobile web UI passed admin login, dashboard, scenario switching, data fields/save, admin team invite visibility/modal open, collaborator login, and hidden invite at 390x844. One modal close tap was outside viewport in the first combined run.

ui_bugs.issue: On Expo web preview at 390x844, the modal close control resolved but Playwright reported it outside the viewport; the screenshot showed the underlying team screen. Needs verification on actual mobile/native and web modal layout.

action_items: Investigate team-modal-close positioning/viewport behavior in Expo web preview and native modal.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.ts resolves Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl before EXPO_BACKEND_URL; confirm the canonical EXPO_BACKEND_URL must have priority in all builds.
The existing backend test fallback hardcodes the preview URL instead of requiring EXPO_BACKEND_URL; this is a test configuration concern, not a production flow failure.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core flows passed; modal close interaction finding)

seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded admin/collaborator and restored campaign values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin and collaborator credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md worked. Collaborator team invite was absent and backend POST /api/team returned 403 in regression. Combined UI run reached modal open; close tap was the only UI finding.
rca_of_issue: Likely Expo web Modal/layout positioning or a transient transition state: team-modal-close was present but outside the 390x844 viewport, and the resulting screenshot showed the team page. Reproduce with admin login, Team tab, Convidar, then inspect modal bounding box and close control after animation settles.
